name: HQB Future Leaders Scholarship (SCU Business)
summary: $5,000 for an SCU Bachelor of Business student starting their final year with a credit average or better.
who: Starting the final year of the Bachelor of Business at SCU, on campus or online.
how: Apply through SCU's applying for a scholarship page with a 100 to 200 word statement.
catches: HQB Accountants may offer the recipient a graduate role.

source.label: Southern Cross University: HQB Future Leaders Scholarship

evidence.quote: Students must provide their academic transcript showing a credit average or greater
